title: Medusa's evolution
summary: Xiao Yan thanks Yao Ming for protecting Medusa and fights Huang Tian himself. Huang Tian is furious that Xiao Yan uses his clan's Heaven Demon Phoenix Wings and can keep up with his Demon Phoenix Step, and Xiao Yan hurts him with the Yellow Spring Palm and the Fire Condensation Finger. Huang Tian takes the true form of the Heaven Demon Phoenix, and Xiao Yan answers with soul attacks, the bane of demon beasts. Then a bloodline pressure suppresses Huang Tian as Medusa comes out of her seclusion. She tells Xiao Yan she found her ancestors' lair deep under the Nine Serene Spring and took their remnant souls into her body, and so evolved into the Nine-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python. Huang Tian gives up, but when they move to kill him he says he lured Xiao Yan away from the Central Plains and that Zi Yan, the new Dragon Emperor of the Void Ancient Dragons, is in danger. Xiao Yan leaves the rest to Yao Ming and sets off with Medusa, taking Huang Tian along.
events: Xiao Yan thanks Yao Ming and faces Huang Tian.

Huang Tian warns that Zi Yan is in danger.
Xiao Yan leaves for the Void Ancient Dragons.
